import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create the visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='pclass', y='survived', hue='sex', data=df, palette='viridis', errorbar=None)

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Survival Rate on the Titanic by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)

# Customize x-axis ticks for better readability
plt.xticks(ticks=[0, 1, 2], labels=['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')

# Add grid for better readability
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

# Ensure layout is tight
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
